run_base_sweep: run the bbb sweep over network parameters including learning rate, sigma_1, and num_batches
run_prior_sweep: run the bbb sweep over prior parameters including sigma_1, sigma_2, and mixture_scale
run_network_sweep: run the bbb sweep over network architecture with different hidden_sizes configurations
run_combined_sweep: run the combined bbb sweep aggregating base, prior, and network sweeps
create_paper_agent: create a paper agent with default bbb config, make_agent constructor, and combined sweep
